scope: Three production stories were measured before local remediation. The workspace candidates below are scheduled source records; they are not production editorial records and were not published by this task.

measurement.productionBodyWordCount: The production audit counted story-body headings, paragraphs, and table cells.
measurement.workspaceBodyWordCount: Whitespace-separated words in story-body headings and paragraphs; summaries and takeaways are excluded.
measurement.workspaceEditorialWordCount: getStoryWordCount(): dek, body paragraphs, bottom line, why it matters, key takeaways, and what changes.
measurement.readTime: The workspace estimate is derived with getStoryReadTime() from the complete scheduled story.
measurement.comparisonNote: Production and workspace figures refer to different records and must not be read as a production update or parity claim.

productionBaseline.title: The cost of intelligence is becoming a design constraint

productionBaseline.title: Public compute needs public metrics

productionBaseline.title: Reliability is becoming the new AI moat
